title: scenario-evidence.v2
description: Versioned successor to the v1 scenario harness run record (sales-developer-release-kit design §3.6/§4.6). Adds build identity (G1), explicit method (G3), capability linkage (G2), evidence provenance, and a formalized three-valued scenario status mapping to the sign-off template's PASS / PASS WITH NOTES / FAIL. Existing v1 run artifacts (records without a `schema` field) remain readable and are not governed by this schema. This schema is evidence-surface-neutral: any producer (SDK scenario harness, UI journey runner, manual capture) may emit conforming records. Canonical home: kamiwaza-internal/capability-kit/schemas/scenario-evidence.v2.schema.json; the copy in kamiwaza-sdk/tests/e2e/scenarios/schemas/ is a vendored mirror kept byte-identical, drift-checked from this repo's CI.

schema.description: Record-format discriminator. v1 records carry no such field.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run started.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run finished.

sign_off_actor.description: Named actor accountable for signing off this scenario.

ci_job_url.description: CI job URL that produced the record, or null for a local run.

build.description: Build identity the run executed against (closes gap G1). Evidence without a build identity cannot support a staleness query or a validation stamp; producers must refuse to emit a record without one.

method.description: How the evidence was produced (closes gap G3; the automated-coverage ratio is a count over this field).

capability_ids.description: Capability documents this evidence supports (closes gap G2). Items are kebab-case segments, optionally dot-namespaced as area.capability (e.g. "single-sign-on", "workrooms.create"). Each item must match the `id` of a capability document exactly; a near-miss such as "workroom-app-launch" for "workrooms.app-launch" is a different id and silently joins to nothing. May be empty when the mapping has not yet been authored.

evidence_provenance.description: Whether the evidence pre-dates the current kit cycle or was authored within it.

status.description: Scenario-level outcome, three-valued to match the sign-off template's PASS / PASS WITH NOTES / FAIL.

name.description: Step name as declared by the producing runbook/journey.

status.description: Step-level outcome; keeps the richer harness vocabulary (passed/failed/skipped/pending/not_reached).

detail.description: Free-form detail: success summary, skip reason, or failure message.
